name: google-analytics-baby
description: Google Analytics 4 + Google Search Console read-only MCP server. List properties, run GA4 reports, get closed-loop channel performance (including Google Ads cost/ROAS straight from GA4), and read Search Console queries, pages, URL indexing and sitemaps. Read-only by design — no mutations, no confirmations. Feedback & bug reports: Jacek Mariański (jmarianski@trans.eu)
